```{r}
#| label: data-loading-fathom
#| include: false
# Read CSVs produced by --multianalysis
fu <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_fu.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
pu <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_pu.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
cu <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_cu.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
comb <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_comb.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
pufu <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_pufu.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())

# Flood probability + total data
flood_type_labels <- c(fluvial = "River", pluvial = "Rainwater", coastal = "Coastal", combined = "Combined")
flood_prob_data <- list()
flood_total_data <- list()
for (ft_name in c("fu", "pu", "cu", "comb")) {
  prob_file <- file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(ft_name, "_prob.csv"))
  total_file <- file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(ft_name, "_total.csv"))
  if (file.exists(prob_file)) flood_prob_data[[ft_name]] <- read_csv(prob_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(total_file)) flood_total_data[[ft_name]] <- read_csv(total_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
}

# Return period colors and linetypes
prob_colors <- c("1-in-1,000 year" = "#9ECAE1", "1-in-100 year" = "#3182BD", "1-in-10 year" = "#08306B")
prob_linetypes <- c("1-in-1,000 year" = "solid", "1-in-100 year" = "dashed", "1-in-10 year" = "dotted")

# Infrastructure + flood CSVs
.find_csv <- function(pattern) {
  f <- list.files(tabular_dir, full.names = TRUE) %>% str_subset(pattern)
  if (length(f) == 1) tryCatch(read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
}
flood_road <- .find_csv("flood_road")
flood_osm  <- .find_csv("flood_osm")
flood_pop  <- .find_csv("flood_pop")

flood_type_display <- c(fluvial = "Fluvial", pluvial = "Pluvial", coastal = "Coastal", comb = "Combined")

# Helper: plot max probability chart for a flood type
.flood_max_plot <- function(df, ft_key, ft_label) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0 || !any(df$exposed_km2 > 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    print_text(paste_bold(paste("No", ft_label, "flood data available")))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  p <- df %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_line(aes(x = year, y = exposed_km2)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1985, 2020, 5), minor_breaks = seq(1985, 2021, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(c(0.05, 0.05))) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "", y = bquote('Exposed'~km^2)) +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"), axis.title.x = element_blank())

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", paste0("wsf-", ft_key, "-plot.png")), plot = p, device = "png",
         width = 4, height = 3.5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")

  if (!"percent_exposed" %in% names(df)) return(invisible(NULL))
  df_sorted <- df %>% filter(!is.na(percent_exposed)) %>% arrange(year)
  if (nrow(df_sorted) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  first_row <- head(df_sorted, 1)
  last_row <- tail(df_sorted, 1)
  print_paged_df(bind_rows(first_row, last_row))
  print_text(glue("In {paste_bold(first_row$year)}, {paste_bold(round(first_row$exposed_km2, 2))} km² of the built-up area ({paste_bold(first_row$percent_exposed)}) was exposed to {tolower(ft_label)} flooding at a minimum depth of 15 cm"))
  print_text(glue("In {paste_bold(last_row$year)}, {paste_bold(round(last_row$exposed_km2, 2))} km² of the built-up area ({paste_bold(last_row$percent_exposed)}) was exposed"))
}

# Helper: plot return period chart for a flood type
.flood_rp_plot <- function(ft_key, ft_label) {
  prob_file <- file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(ft_key, "_prob.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(prob_file)) return(invisible(NULL))

  prob_df <- read_csv(prob_file, col_types = cols())
  if ("0.1-1%" %in% names(prob_df) && !"1-in-1,000 year" %in% names(prob_df)) {
    prob_df <- prob_df %>% rename(
      `1-in-1,000 year` = `0.1-1%`, `1-in-100 year` = `1-10%`, `1-in-10 year` = `>10%`)
  }
  rp_cols <- intersect(c("1-in-1,000 year", "1-in-100 year", "1-in-10 year"), names(prob_df))
  prob_df <- prob_df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(rp_cols), names_to = "probability", values_to = "area_km2") %>%
    mutate(probability = factor(probability, levels = c("1-in-1,000 year", "1-in-100 year", "1-in-10 year")))

  p <- prob_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = yearName, y = area_km2, color = probability, linetype = probability, group = probability)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1984, 2024, 10)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(c(0.05, 0.05))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = prob_colors) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = prob_linetypes) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste0("Built-up area exposed to ", tolower(ft_label), " flooding"),
         y = bquote('Exposed urban built-up area,'~km^2),
         color = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom")

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", paste0("wsf-", ft_key, "-prob-plot.png")), plot = p, device = "png",
         width = 5, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")

  last_row <- prob_df %>% filter(yearName == max(yearName))
  for (rp in rp_cols) {
    val <- last_row %>% filter(probability == rp) %>% pull(area_km2)
    if (length(val) == 0) next
    print_text(paste0(ft_label, " ", paste_bold(rp), " return period: ", paste_bold(round(val, 2)), " km² exposed by ", max(prob_df$yearName)))
  }
}

# Helper: print population table + text for a flood type
.flood_pop_table <- function(ft_key) {
  if (is.null(flood_pop) || nrow(flood_pop) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  pop_ft <- flood_pop %>% filter(str_detect(type, ft_key))
  if (nrow(pop_ft) > 0) {
    cat("\n\n#### Population Exposure\n\n")
    print_paged_df(pop_ft)
    print_text(paste("Percentage of population dense areas (>60th percentile density) in flood zone:",
      paste_bold(paste0(round(pop_ft$exposed_dense_pop_pct[1], 1), "%"))))
  }
}

# Helper: print Flood + WSF stats table for a flood type
.flood_wsf_table <- function(ft_key) {
  if (!exists("flood_total_data") || length(flood_total_data) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  if (!(ft_key %in% names(flood_total_data))) return(invisible(NULL))
  ft_label_map <- c(fu = "River", pu = "Rainwater", cu = "Coastal", comb = "Combined")
  ft_label <- ft_label_map[ft_key]
  cat(paste0("\n\n#### ", ft_label, " — Flood + WSF Stats\n\n"))
  print_paged_df(flood_total_data[[ft_key]])
}

# Helper: print infrastructure tables + text for a flood type
.flood_infra_table <- function(ft_key) {
  ft_pattern <- paste0("^", ft_key)
  flood_label <- c(fluvial = "riverine", pluvial = "surface water", coastal = "coastal", comb = "riverine, surface water, or coastal")[[ft_key]]

  has_data <- FALSE

  # Tables first
  if (!is.null(flood_road) && nrow(flood_road) > 0) {
    road_ft <- flood_road %>% filter(str_detect(type, ft_pattern))
    if (nrow(road_ft) > 0) {
      cat("\n\n#### Roads in Flood Zone\n\n")
      print_paged_df(road_ft)
      has_data <- TRUE
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(flood_osm) && nrow(flood_osm) > 0) {
    osm_ft <- flood_osm %>% filter(str_detect(type, ft_pattern))
    if (nrow(osm_ft) > 0) {
      cat("\n\n#### Infrastructure in Flood Zone\n\n")
      print_paged_df(osm_ft %>% select(-type))
      has_data <- TRUE
    }
  }

  if (!has_data) return(invisible(NULL))

  # Narrative text after tables
  road_str <- NULL
  if (!is.null(flood_road) && nrow(flood_road) > 0) {
    road_row <- flood_road %>% filter(str_detect(type, ft_pattern))
    if (nrow(road_row) > 0) road_str <- paste0(round(road_row$percentage_in_flood_zones[1], 1), "% of major roads")
  }
  osm_parts <- c()
  if (!is.null(flood_osm) && nrow(flood_osm) > 0) {
    osm_ft <- flood_osm %>% filter(str_detect(type, ft_pattern))
    for (poi_name in c("schools", "health", "fire", "police")) {
      row <- osm_ft %>% filter(poi == poi_name)
      if (nrow(row) > 0) {
        poi_label <- c(schools = "schools", health = "health facilities", fire = "fire stations", police = "police stations")[[poi_name]]
        osm_parts <- c(osm_parts, paste(row$pois_in_flood_zone[1], "in", row$total_pois[1], poi_label))
      }
    }
  }
  all_parts <- c(road_str, osm_parts)
  if (length(all_parts) > 0) {
    print_text(paste(paste_bold(paste_and(all_parts)),
      "are located in a", paste_bold(flood_label), "flood risk zone with a minimum depth of 15 cm"))
  }
}
```

### Combined Fluvial, Pluvial & Coastal

```{r}
#| label: combined-flood
#| results: asis

# Combined max probability chart (with individual lines)
if (!exists('pufu') || is.null(pufu) || nrow(pufu) == 0) print_text(paste_bold('No Combined flood data available')) else {

  pufu_plot <- pufu %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = year, y = exposed_km2, color = type)) +
    geom_line(data = \(d) filter(d, type == "Combined")) +
    geom_point(data = \(d) filter(d, type != "Combined")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1985, 2020, 5), minor_breaks = seq(1985, 2021, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(River = "#F8766D", Rainwater = "#619CFF", Coastal = "#00BA38", Combined = "black")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    labs(title = "", y = bquote('Exposed'~km^2), color = "") +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"), axis.title.x = element_blank())
  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "wsf-pufu-plot.png"), plot = pufu_plot, device = "png",
         width = 4, height = 3.5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(pufu_plot)
  cat("\n\n")

  comb_sorted <- comb %>% filter(!is.na(percent_exposed)) %>% arrange(year)
  first_row <- head(comb_sorted, 1)
  last_row <- tail(comb_sorted, 1)
  print_paged_df(bind_rows(first_row, last_row))
  print_text(glue("In {paste_bold(first_row$year)}, {paste_bold(round(first_row$exposed_km2, 2))} km² of the built-up area ({paste_bold(first_row$percent_exposed)}) was exposed to riverine, surface water, or coastal flooding at a minimum depth of 15 cm"))
  print_text(glue("In {paste_bold(last_row$year)}, {paste_bold(round(last_row$exposed_km2, 2))} km² of the built-up area ({paste_bold(last_row$percent_exposed)}) was exposed"))
}

# Harmonized WSF + flood chart
if (!exists("flood_total_data") || length(flood_total_data) == 0) print_text(paste_bold("No harmonized flood total data available")) else {

  ft_label_map <- c(fu = "River", pu = "Rainwater", cu = "Coastal", comb = "Combined")
  flood_total_labeled <- flood_total_data
  names(flood_total_labeled) <- ft_label_map[names(flood_total_labeled)]
  flood_total <- bind_rows(flood_total_labeled, .id = "type")

  flood_harm_plot <- flood_total %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = uba_km2_exposed, color = type)) +
    geom_line(data = \(d) filter(d, type == "Combined")) +
    geom_point(data = \(d) filter(d, type != "Combined")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1985, 2025, 5), minor_breaks = seq(1985, 2025, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(River = "#F8766D", Rainwater = "#619CFF", Coastal = "#00BA38", Combined = "black")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "",
         y = bquote('Exposed Urban Built-up Area,'~km^2),
         color = NULL) +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom")
  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "wsf-flood-harmonized-plot.png"), plot = flood_harm_plot, device = "png",
         width = 5, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(flood_harm_plot)
  cat("\n\n")

  for (ft in names(flood_total_labeled)) {
    d <- flood_total_labeled[[ft]]
    print_text(paste0(
      paste_bold(ft), ": from ", paste_bold(round(d$uba_km2_exposed[1], 2)), " km² exposed in ",
      d$Year[1], " to ", paste_bold(round(tail(d$uba_km2_exposed, 1), 2)), " km² in ",
      tail(d$Year, 1), " (", paste_bold(tail(d$percent_uba_exposed, 1)), " of built-up area)"))
  }
}

.flood_wsf_table("comb")
.flood_pop_table("comb")
.flood_infra_table("comb")
```
